about: What the web copy may not say on an ORDINARY page (one outside the assistant section) while help/facts.json -> assistantOnTheWeb is false, and which ordinary pages it leaves out altogether. Ruled by Russell 2026-11-12 (#804): plantoir.app never presents Plantoir as needing a paid assistant, and shows unit planning and the Coverage tab only after GitHub Copilot support has shipped and he has judged it reasonable. A sentence or block that must say one of these goes in an {{assistant}} ... {{/assistant}} run: it stays in the Mac Help book and is left out of the web copy. The check reads the RENDERED web page (token text, code, alt text, titles, link targets, the contents page), and --web and --release-web FAIL on an unmarked mention, naming its file and line; --check and --mac print it as a warning. Who changes this file: the director, on Russell's ruling that #804 has lifted (the same ruling that turns assistantOnTheWeb on). Each term is a case-insensitive regular expression with its reason.

pages.why: Its subject is the Coverage tab, which the site shows only after #804 lifts.
